description: This file contains unit tests and related functions for the PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) module, specifically for handling NIST test policies in certificate validation.

classes.name: PkitsTestInfo
classes.description: A class managing the configuration of PKI test policies, including initial policies, user constraints, and various policy flags.

methods.name: SetInitialExplicitPolicy
methods.description: Sets whether the initial explicit policy is enabled or disabled.

methods.name: SetInitialPolicyMappingInhibit
methods.description: Sets whether the initial policy mapping inhibit is enabled or disabled.

methods.name: SetInitialInhibitAnyPolicy
methods.description: Sets whether the initial inhibit any policy flag is enabled or disabled.

methods.name: SetInitialPolicySet
methods.description: Sets the initial policy set from a comma-separated string of policy names.

methods.name: SetUserConstrainedPolicySet
methods.description: Sets the user constrained policy set from a comma-separated string of policy names.
